title: Covalent Molecular Glues: Mechanisms, Design Principles, and Emerging Therapeutic Opportunities in Targeted Protein Degradation.
authors: Al-Karmalawy, Ahmed A; Attia, Mohamed Ibrahim; Yousef, Tarek A; Al-Qazzan, Mohammed Bashar; Al-Akeedi, Mohammed; Khatib, Arwa Omar Al; Hawas, Samia S
one_liner_zh: 综述共价分子胶在靶向蛋白降解中的机制与设计，虽涉及转录因子降解但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，AI方法仅提及共价对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Targeted protein degradation (TPD) has revolutionized modern drug discovery by enabling the catalytic and selective removal of disease-driving proteins that are beyond the reach of traditional inhibition. Among emerging TPD modalities, covalent molecular glues represent a rapidly expanding class of small molecules that combine the interface-inducing behavior of classical molecular glues with the durable target engagement of covalent chemistry. These compounds initiate non-covalent recognition events and subsequently form selective covalent bonds with nucleophilic residues, stabilizing weak or non-native protein-protein interactions to promote ubiquitination or functional modulation. This review provides a comprehensive overview of covalent molecular glues, encompassing natural products, synthetic scaffolds, warhead strategies, and mechanistic foundations governing covalent anchoring, cooperativity, and neo-interface formation. Key examples-including DCAF16-, FBXO22-, UBE2D-, and 14-3-3sigma-targeting glues-highlight their capacity to engage challenging protein surfaces, remodel ubiquitin ligase specificity, and degrade previously undruggable substrates such as transcription factors and KRAS G12C. We further discuss technological advances driving rational discovery, including covalent fragment-based screening, electrophile library profiling, chemoproteomics, and AI-guided covalent docking. Finally, we summarize therapeutic opportunities across oncology, neurodegeneration, and immunomodulation, while outlining current challenges and future directions needed to expand the ligase landscape, improve safety, and achieve predictive design. Covalent molecular glues are poised to become a foundational modality in next-generation precision therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 靶向蛋白降解（TPD）通过实现传统抑制手段无法触及的致病蛋白的催化性和选择性清除，彻底革新了现代药物发现领域。在新兴的TPD模式中，共价分子胶代表了一类快速扩展的小分子，它们结合了经典分子胶的界面诱导行为与共价化学的持久靶点结合特性。这些化合物启动非共价识别事件，随后与亲核残基形成选择性共价键，稳定弱或非天然蛋白-蛋白相互作用，以促进泛素化或功能调节。本综述全面概述了共价分子胶，涵盖天然产物、合成骨架、弹头策略以及控制共价锚定、协同性和新界面形成的机制基础。关键实例——包括靶向DCAF16、FBXO22、UBE2D和14-3-3σ的分子胶——突显了它们结合挑战性蛋白表面、重塑泛素连接酶特异性以及降解先前不可成药底物（如转录因子和KRAS G12C）的能力。我们进一步讨论了推动理性发现的技术进展，包括共价片段筛选、亲电体库分析、化学蛋白质组学以及AI引导的共价对接。最后，我们总结了肿瘤学、神经退行性疾病和免疫调节领域的治疗机会，同时概述了当前挑战和未来方向，以扩展连接酶谱系、提高安全性并实现预测性设计。共价分子胶有望成为下一代精准治疗的基础性模式。
